payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_75913077f2d2) executing UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 waiting on Lock: transactionid, blocked by pid 714 (session_02f22672d2f0), which is 'idle in transaction' after having run the same UPDATE and holds the row/transaction lock while awaiting client input. No other blocking chain upstream (blocking_session_ids empty for 714), so it is the root blocker. The table is tiny (2 rows, PK index only, no bloat/vacuum issues), ruling out large-data, index, or vacuum causes. Resolution: roll back the eligible idle-in-transaction session_02f22672d2f0 to release the lock, preserving the business request. Uncertainty: none material; observation is current (2026-11-05T04:20:06Z).
